name: B10-0057/2024 (PPE) – The devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its position and asking the European Union to act after the floods in central and eastern Europe. It wants quick money and practical help for the affected countries, stronger shared emergency services, more spending on flood protection and early warning systems, and a new plan to help Europe adapt to climate change. It also thanks the rescue workers and volunteers.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests to the European Commission and member states.
- **Who it affects:** People and regions hit by floods, farmers, rescue services and local councils.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its demands to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to act.
